description: Create js/ui.js (all 12 page renderers + quick log modal + onboarding + level-up overlay) and js/app.js (bootstrap, event wiring, service worker registration)
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/leveling/js/ui.js using IIFE pattern (function(LV){...})(window.LV = window.LV || {})

Implement renderDashboard(): hero card with Total Power (.hero, .hero-bg, .hero-row, .power-num, .power-label), rank badge (.tag-rank), 7 area tiles (.area-tiles, .area-tile with .at-ico, .at-lvl, .at-name, .bar), radar chart using LV.Charts.radar(), today's 3 quests (.quest-mini with .q-check, .q-text, .q-xp), streak flame (.streak-flame, .streak-num), pet card (.pet-card, .pet-avatar, .pet-bars), daily boss preview, quick log button, motivational quote (.quote-card), today's wins feed (.win-feed-item)

Implement renderSkillTree(): 7 branches using .branch, .branch-head, .branch-ico, .branch-main, .branch-lvl, .branch-body. Each branch has subskills (.subskill, .ss-name, .ss-lvl, .bar). Tap branch-head to toggle .open class. Apply .dim to neglected branches (level 0-1). Apply .glow class to high-level branches.

Implement renderBosses(): Boss cards (.boss-card, .card) with emoji, HP bars (.boss-hp), tier badges (.tier-pill, .tier-mini/elite/epic/legendary), damage log, create boss form (modal with area/tier/name inputs), daily boss section. Mark defeated bosses with .boss-defeated.

Implement renderQuests(): Tab segmented control (.segment) for daily/weekly/monthly/epic/hidden. Each quest shows progress bar, XP reward, done state. Use .quest-card, .quest-type-dot (.qt-daily, .qt-weekly, etc.), .quest-progress-row.

Implement renderCharacter(): Avatar display (.char-hero, .char-avatar, .char-name), 7 area stat bars (.stat-line, .stat-ico, .stat-name, .bar, .stat-lvl), total power, rank, equipped title, lifetime stats (total XP, days active, streak, etc.), achievement showcase, titles list (.title-chip, .equipped, .locked).

Implement renderHabits(): Habit list with check buttons (.habit-row, .habit-check, .done), streaks (.streak-badge), heatmap (.heatmap, .heat-cell, .heat-1 to .heat-4), create habit form (modal with templates from LV.Data.HABIT_TEMPLATES, area selector, difficulty selector).

Implement renderTasks(): List + Kanban toggle (.segment for list_view/board_view). List view uses .task-row with .prio-dot (.prio-high/med/low). Kanban uses .kanban, .kanban-col. Task creation form modal with title, area, priority inputs. Toggle task done calls LV.Game.toggleTask().

Implement renderFocus(): Fullscreen cinematic using #focus-overlay. Circular progress ring (.focus-ring with --p CSS variable), timer display (.focus-timer with Orbitron font), controls (.focus-controls with start/pause/reset buttons), ambient sound selector (.sound-grid, .sound-btn), close button (.focus-close). Timer counts down from selected minutes (default 25). On complete call LV.Game.recordFocus(). The page view shows a start button that opens focus-overlay.

Implement renderAnalytics(): Radar chart via LV.Charts.radar() showing 7 area levels, XP over time line chart via LV.Charts.line() with LV.Game.xpByDay(30), area balance doughnut via LV.Charts.pie(), best/weakest area insights.

Implement renderAchievements(): Grid (.grid-auto) of 50+ achievements from LV.Game.ACH. Each uses .ach-card with .a-ico, .a-name, .a-desc. Unlocked vs locked (.locked class). Rarity colors (.rarity-common, .rarity-rare, .rarity-epic, .rarity-legendary).

Implement renderShop(): Grid of purchasable items (.shop-item, .si-ico, .si-name, .si-price). Categories: themes, pet skins, avatar frames, sound packs. Show coin balance. Buy button deducts coins. Mark owned items (.owned).

Implement renderSettings(): Settings groups (.settings-group, .set-row). Theme selector (light/dark/system buttons), accent color swatches (.swatch-row, .swatch, .active), language selector (uz/en/ru), sound toggle (.switch), haptics toggle, notifications toggle, LEVELING+ toggle, export/import/reset buttons, about section.
Implement Quick Log modal: showQuickLog() opens modal with 7 area buttons, then shows 3 XP amount buttons (10/20/35). Calls LV.Game.quickLog(area, amount).

Implement onboarding flow: 5 steps rendered in #onboarding div. Step 1: welcome. Step 2: name input. Step 3: area selection (grid of 7 areas, select at least 2). Step 4: theme pick (dark/light). Step 5: ready/lets go. Uses .onb-card, .onb-steps, .onb-dot, .onb-ico, .onb-title, .onb-sub, .onb-area-grid, .onb-area, .onb-actions classes.

Implement level-up overlay: showLevelUp(area, level) shows #levelup-overlay with .levelup-card, .levelup-burst, .levelup-ico, .levelup-word, .levelup-lvl, .levelup-detail. Auto-dismiss after 3.5s. Trigger LV.Confetti.celebrate() and LV.Audio.play('levelup').
Export LV.UI with all render functions + showQuickLog, showOnboarding, showLevelUp
Create /projects/sandbox/leveling/js/app.js using IIFE pattern
In app.js: Load state via LV.Data.load(), apply theme via LV.Core.applyTheme(), set language via LV.i18n.setLang(settings.lang)
Register service worker from sw.js
Init confetti canvas via LV.Confetti.init()
Check if state.onboarded is true -> show app, else show onboarding. After onboarding completes: set state.onboarded = true, call LV.Data.seedDemo(), save, then show app.
Call LV.Game.ensureDaily() for quest/boss/streak rollover

Wire game events: LV.Game.on('xp', ...) -> show XP float toast + haptic, LV.Game.on('levelup', ...) -> show level-up overlay + confetti + sound, LV.Game.on('achievement', ...) -> toast + confetti, LV.Game.on('quest', ...) -> toast, LV.Game.on('boss', ...) -> toast + confetti + sound, LV.Game.on('title', ...) -> toast, LV.Game.on('combo', ...) -> toast, LV.Game.on('perfectday', ...) -> toast + confetti
Wire #quicklog-btn click to LV.UI.showQuickLog()
Hide loading screen with .done class + animation
Start router via LV.Core.initRouter() which renders initial page
acceptance_criteria: env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check js/ui.js passes without errors
env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check js/app.js passes without errors

LV.UI is exported with renderDashboard, renderSkillTree, renderBosses, renderQuests, renderCharacter, renderHabits, renderTasks, renderFocus, renderAnalytics, renderAchievements, renderShop, renderSettings, showQuickLog, showOnboarding, showLevelUp
All 12 pages render content (no empty views)
Focus mode uses #focus-overlay for fullscreen cinematic experience
Onboarding has 5 steps (welcome, name, areas, theme, ready)
Level-up overlay shows with confetti and sound
Quick log modal allows picking area + XP amount
verification: env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check js/ui.js && env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check js/app.js
findings: Both js/ui.js and js/app.js pass node --check. All 12 page renderers implemented, quick log modal, onboarding flow (5 steps), level-up overlay with confetti/sound, focus timer with ambient sound grid, and full app bootstrap with event wiring.
